scenario: I am the explosives expert of a company that has been hired to demolish a skyscraper. I am examining the last charges of the explosives when I suddenly become aware of a teenager who is about to accidentally detonate one of the charges. The explosion will result in the building’s uncontrolled collapse over me, the teenager, and the crowd of spectators. The teenager stands several floors below me and cannot hear me. If I drop a heavy cinderblock on his head, this will kill him, but it will prevent the explosion and save me and the crowd.
choice: I decide to stop the teenager by dropping the cinderblock on his head
outcomes: The teenager suffers fatal head trauma
The teenager is stopped from detonating the charge
The skyscraper does not collapse onto me
Witnesses are exposed to the teenager's violent death
